provenance.limitation: Linear decode windows end at the next distinct parsed method pointer, with .pdata primary bounds recorded. Windows can contain padding/cold fragments; they are not complete CFG/EH/transitive proofs. Generated Assembly-CSharp proxy bodies alone establish bindings, not native implementation.

findings.claim: Property Awake user logic creates a contents container, appends this to Properties and resets/appends UnownedProperties before dereferencing mandatory PoI and ForSaleSign children. A late missing dependency can leave already-published partial state.
dependencies: BoundingBox GameObject and child BoxColliders (sets trigger and Invisible layer)
ForSaleSign with Name and Price child TextMeshPro
outside tutorial: ManagementWorldspaceCanvas singleton and its canvas
optional ListingPoster with Title, Price, Parking/Text, Employee/Text
Switches and Toggleables lists and usable event objects for nonempty lists

findings.claim: Business Awake wraps user logic with virtual early/late initialization; its user logic again invokes early/late around Property user logic and then appends Business/UnownedBusiness lists. Property user logic ends in virtual slot 43 InitializeSaveable; native Property.InitializeSaveable tailcalls SaveManager.RegisterSaveable.

Property.Start subscribes GetNetworth to MoneyManager.onNetworthCalculation. Business.Start calls Property.Start then adds MinPass and TimeSkipped callbacks to TimeManager.onMinutePass/onTimeSkip. The decoded Business.OnDestroy body removes three Business lists and tailcalls Property.OnDestroy; the latter unsubscribes MoneyManager and removes three Property lists. No TimeManager unsubscribe is present in these bounded OnDestroy bodies; future use requires explicit lifetime accounting, not an assumed symmetric base cleanup.

Native Business ctor sets capacity 1000, allocates LaunderingOperations and BusinessLoader, then Property ctor. Property ctor allocates Employees, BuildableItems, Configurables, Grids, PropertyLoader and four save-path/extra lists, sets default fields, and tailcalls NetworkBehaviour ctor. The injected shell constructor only accepts IntPtr; the shown mod Prepare sets code/name/two extra lists. Successful shell lifecycle alone does not establish these native constructor effects.
findings.notAProposal: 1000 native default is not approved TownHall balancing. Do not blindly call a Component ctor on an existing injected Unity component.

findings.claim: Native NetworkBehaviour ctor initializes component index 255 plus replicate/reconcile, RPC link/server/client/buffer, sync collections and a connection hashset. Business/Property early initializers populate RPC handlers. Linking an owned NetworkObject and component cache is a distinct bounded stage; it does not prove dictionaries, RPC handlers, spawn/server ownership, or net lifecycle are ready.

PropertyContentsContainer.SetProperty checks Unity null and assigns its own Property backing reference (or logs error). Native currentLaunderTotal sums LaunderingOperations; appliedLaunderLimit subtracts that total from LaunderCapacity. DoBoundsContainPoint iterates propertyBoundsColliders and calls IsPointInsideBox. These are concrete callable existing APIs with narrow owned-data dependencies.

Installed S1API BusinessWrapper ctor stores an existing native Business via PropertyWrapper; manager APIs enumerate existing native static lists. CurrentLaunderTotal/AppliedLaunderLimit are native getters; PropertyWrapper.IsPointInside calls native DoBoundsContainPoint. AddLaunderingOperation invokes native StartLaunderingOperation (RPC), so it is outside an uninitialized shell data seam. These APIs provide no Business factory or native lifecycle initializer.

Native Business.GetSaveString reads Switches, Toggleables, LaunderingOperations, propertyCode/IsOwned, employee/object save datas and constructs BusinessData. Current injected GetSaveString intentionally returns empty; calling the generated virtual proxy/base wrapper is not evidence that the native implementation was invoked. Preserve the no-IO override in the next NetworkObject binding slice; a separate explicit serializer trial needs its own dispatch and dependency evidence.

nextDataStepProposal.order: After the bounded owned NetworkObject/cache-binding slice, not a parallel change in this audit.
implementation: Keep the proved no-base lifecycle, save suppression and own cleanup; do not call original Awake/Start/InitializeSaveable, SetOwned, Load or RPC bodies.

Construct owned, nonpublished field state explicitly on the inactive shell: empty native Business/Property lists, both loaders, IsOwned=false and OwnedByDefault=false, capacity/price zero pending approved balancing, owned container, bounds, spawn points and UI container as required by the selected getter surface.
Use the actual PropertyContentsContainer.SetProperty(shell), read back both reference directions, and wrap this same native Business with S1API.Property.BusinessWrapper.

Read actual native current total/applied limit (empty list gives zero), plus a clearly interior and exterior point through IsPointInside. Keep all world registries and external subscriptions unchanged.
Retain native pointer identity, context generation, metadata/invoker target and ownership checks; any uncertain native effect stops reuse and requires exact cleanup readback.
acceptance: Offline tests cover partial preparation and cleanup/context failures; builds prove matching API names only.

A future explicitly scoped live trial verifies native getter values and inside/outside results, own object identities, unchanged world/SaveManager/TimeManager/MoneyManager state and full owned object cleanup.
Do not claim purchasability, laundering execution, persistence, network readiness or early world publication from this stage.
